title: Duck Totems (Slim)
description: Replaces totem texture with a duck.
body:
This pack turns the default totem texture into a **duck**. There are 2 versions: **Slim** and **Thick**. This is the **slim** version.

**Thick version: https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/duck-totems-thick**
**Changelog: https://github.com/oilmine/ducktotems** Look at the Gallery for the picture. If you like this pack, share this to your friends!
I would also appreciate if you can follow me or this project. **Thank you for downloading this pack, have a good day :)**
